description: This file defines the Order model class within the Opencart system, specifically handling customer order data, retrieval of order details, orders list, order histories, and related information for the account namespace.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents the customer order data and provides methods to retrieve order details, list orders, and manage order histories and related entities.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific order by its ID, including payment/shipping details, status, totals, and associated data.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches a list of orders for the current customer with pagination support.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves orders associated with a specific subscription ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Gets detailed information for a specific product within an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns all products associated with a given order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a particular order product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Fetches subscription details linked to a specific order and order product.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Returns all vouchers associated with the specified order.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves total amounts related to an order, such as subtotal, shipping, taxes, and total.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Fetches the history entries (status changes, comments) for a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts the total number of history entries for a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Returns the total count of all orders for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProductId
methods.description: Calculates total number of orders containing a specific product ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts total number of products in an order by order ID.

methods.name: getTotalVouchersByOrderId
methods.description: Counts total number of vouchers used in an order by order ID.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Counts total number of orders associated with a specific subscription ID for the current customer.
